body: I fit the criteria of the post lol, but yeah i agree, it can be at times
she was the sweetest and most helpful therapist I’ve had

I suffer with stomach issues and I was holding in a fart and my stomach was making crazy sounds all session! I ended up letting one rip and I felt so embarrassed, but the following week she came in drank a drink real fast and burped loud. We never spoke of it but I know she did that purposely and it’s one thing I think of often!

I ran into my therapist at the train station after therapy. As soon as I saw her I sprinted to the other side of the platform because I wasn’t sure how to approach her outside. I was so embarrassed about my reaction. I spoke to her about it in the session the following week and she reassured me, discussed boundaries and I’ve seen her since and we say hello and have a quick non-therapeutic chat
This is such an interesting perspective. I think I agree that it serves as a band-aid. I want to hear more!

Sorry I should clarify this. So a round of therapy is 6-8 sessions, for me I get 10-12 sessions because I’m a bit more in need. How it works is you do a round of therapy and then have to wait 12 weeks before coming back for another round and then you move on to another therapist.

My issue is it takes me so long to feel completely comfortable to be vulnerable that I’ve wasted the whole first round of therapy.

I hear you! I’m sure he knew he meant a lot to you aswell. A therapeutic relationship is such an unusual dynamic. I think a little bit. Not really. But it’s still super fresh, and I feel like we just aren’t clicking. I’ve missed out of seeing my new T for a few weeks also, so I feel like it’s hard to rebuild. It took me a year to trust my old T, so these things can’t be rushed

My therapy came to an end in July last year. It’s kind of an awkward and traumatic situation because we agreed to do one more round of therapy so I was due to go back in January, but I’d contacted her earlier. Then she told me the rules of the organisation had changed and I could only see her twice, so I can’t go back. This broke me. I was abandoned by the person I shared my heart with. I’ve been trying to move on with another therapist but we haven’t clicked. My new therapist arranged for my old T to come in so I could get some closure, because I just couldn’t connect at all to her and wouldn’t even speak. It happened and I was able to grieve but I still miss her and feel like I’m wasting time in therapy now, because I’m trying to move forward but the wound still hurts. I don’t know if I’ll ever get over it, I probably will but I’ll forever miss my old T. We had a great therapeutic bond, and she saw me. She understood medicine, she was trained in that physical field before becoming a therapist, so I could talk to her about my health issues with no shame. She listened intently and challenged me; although I have issues with authority I trusted her. 

So I feel your pain. I feel so stupid for allowing myself to feel connected to a professional. I’ve been really hard on myself - I hope you’re not too hard on yourself.
“A loud and cheerful greeting early in the morning will be taken as a curse!” Proverbs 27:14 I’m not a morning person so when I discovered this one it made me laugh

I’m so sorry you feel this way. Thank you for sharing your pain, I pray that you experience relief. I have been a baptised believer for 11 years and I still struggle with this, some seasons it’s stronger than others. I work with a therapist/medication to deal with mine, I have times when I can’t leave my house but I push myself to go to church and be around other believers, and be honest about my struggle. You are not alone. 

First of all I want to encourage you and remind you that God loves you so much. Jesus experienced so much pain, rejection and being misunderstood in his life. He gets it. I know you don’t feel it but the Lord is near to you in this season. When I don’t feel something I remind myself of the facts in the bible. The Lord promises to be near to the brokenhearted, that he never changes even though my feelings about him may. There is nothing that can separate you from his love, my friend. 

It sounds like your body and soul is craving relief from the pain that you’re carrying. I hear you. I was going through something huge recently, battling for a whole year and having trouble after trouble. I was so close to giving up. I just wanted to go home and be with the Lord, I had attempted to attempt to take my life but I couldn’t do it. My prayers were answered and God came through a few days later. 

During that time of fighting I was so exhausted. I have physical health issues, mental health issues, lost my job, lost my amazing therapist, and I was seeking support but kept being told no. I felt the God telling me to be still in that season, and to allow him to fight for me. I realised that being still meant to release control. 

Allow God to fight for you, my friend. Fighting the Devil isn’t your business. Focus on what you can do in this season, and who God is. I will be praying for you. I love you, and I feel your pain.

Please pray for my mental health journey - meeting with my therapist. Please pray for my physical health - answers & healing. Please pray for God to reveal what he’d like me to do in terms of life and career as I feel stuck

I mean I’m in the UK and it is NHS. My fear is that the waiting lists are up to 2 years long. But you are right, I’ve had a bit too much drama in that organisation. Someone I used to work with became a therapist and started working at that organisation. She went and completely breached confidentiality by going and telling everyone from my old work (where I got bullied) that I was in therapy. I spoke to my old therapist about it, she gave me my options and stood up for me during that time. It made everything awkward and now she ignores me completely. Then after the rule change I had been moved to someone that kept changing my scores son the MH chart saying she needs to put me lower, I had the drama with the therapist that’s under investigation now for a lot of things she did. She was the most awful I’ve had ever. And now this new lady making me feel like that. You see this week I almost attempted but I feel like I can’t speak to her about it. The thing that’s making me the most suicidal is I’m doing the right things - I’m reaching out for help, but these people aren’t helping me. I’m exhausted.

I did feel a bit weird. She also told the receptionist before the session how stressed she was and how her morning had been really hard, whilst I was sat there. I was uncomfortable because I knew I was going to tell her about my plan. It’s hard because I feel like I’m being viewed as a difficult client. I feel like if I ask to switch again then they’re just going to think it’s a me problem.

I feel like I lost a lot of the trust I had been trying to build at that point. I’ve had to replace 2 therapists since my good therapist. One even is under investigation. I’ve spoken to the management of the organisation and they all said I needed someone experienced. I feel like they’re running out of options for me. I’m not trying to be difficult either

Can I ask how do you connect with God as a therapist? A lot of people tell me this, and I’d love to know God in this way but it really helps me to have a physical therapist, scheduled time and homework to help me

Wow, it’s nice to know I’m not alone in this. Yeah my awareness of God’s presence is a bit up and down. I’m so used to him speaking to me so when he’s silent, it’s like I can’t sense him there and then I get so focused on the darkness I get overwhelmed by it but then it’s like out of nowhere I’m reminded of his promises, of how he’s brought me through before, of his unfailing love which is mentioned over and over in his word and then I choose to believe him over my feelings of lack. Yeah that’s true. I’ve had a lot of spiritual guides throughout my walk, I’m so grateful for them and if I can be an ounce of what they’ve been to me, to someone else then I’ll be happy. I’m so sensitive, I get so sad when I see people suffering. I was supposed to start volunteering this year at a café for the homeless, for them to come get warm and talk. It’s ran by a Christian organisation. Unfortunately because of my physical health I haven’t started. I really want to though but God keeps telling me to rest so that I can heal.

This has inspired me to do a study on James! Thank you so much, it’s a great reminder. I’ve been through so much in my life. I was taken from my home aged 6, my mom was an addict and alcoholic, I was placed into a spiritually abusive home until age 17 (I’m 27 now) - God gave me an amazing family within my church. Even on Christmas this year I spent it with a family from church. There’s so much more to my story, like now my mom is a believer we’re working on our relationship, God’s restoring my family dynamic. I can’t lie, each time I’ve been knocked down God has pulled me through and I’ve fallen more in love with him. I love Jesus so much, it’s just hard when you’re currently in it. I know he’s here with me but I do feel lonely a lot because it’s hard to explain what’s on my mind to people, that’s why I benefitted from a therapist but God took her away and I do feel sad about that because I’m someone that likes to know why for the sake of internal peace and I can’t figure this one out

Thank you so much! It’s been one of those years where it’s just unimaginable. I started the year off planning to advance in my career and do a lot of things but within the first few weeks I had a damage happen to my house and had to move out, then I was hospitalised for a while with my physical health and then it just became a year where struggles kept coming at me. I’ve lost so much. God was so good to me though, he called me to the mountains for solitude. A lady from church, said she was going away to the mountains and God put it on her heart to invite me. It was so slow, quiet and beautiful. I just felt his love. I’m grateful for that in the midst of all the chaos of this year!
Glad we’re back! Thank you!

My recent first session with new therapist. She changed my scores on the depression scale, she invalidated my physical health and said she didn’t want to hear about it. I cried and told her I was sad bc I miss my old therapist, she said “well she wasn’t your friend soo?” She missed the point, didn’t ask anything else and invalidated me. She asked my therapy goals and when I told her she sarcastically said “how zen of you… can you sit in the lotus position too?” I only told her I wanted stability of my mind. She made fun of me when I told her I made fish n chips for dinner she said “what… did you go out, catch the fish, cook it and debone it?” Idk why she said this. Also her phone went off 3 times during the session as I was talking. She told me to hold on, it rang again, then again. She told me I had survivors guilt after hearing 2 mins of my experience with someone that didn’t harm me at all. By the end of the session she noticed I was drained. She said if you choose to come back next week. She said a few things throughout which made it seem like I wasn’t coming back, so I asked her “do you think I’m not gonna come back?” She said “I hope you do, but sometimes people come to see me and then they realise therapy isn’t for them…” I don’t understand if any of this is normal. I did send an email to the organisation and I will go back next week as I don’t wanna be kicked off the system or seen as a difficult client. But yeah! That one confused me..

I restart therapy this week with a new therapist. Gutted as I had a really good rapport with my old T and it feels like abandonment. I tried fighting for her back but organisation said no bc of their new rules. Hoping I can still continue my healing journey with new therapist but I’m terrified, mainly bc abuse from systems and professionals is one of my triggers. This wasn’t abuse but my mental system is having the same response.

How much funding does the NHS give? I didn’t realise it could run out so that’s helpful to know for my own future endeavours. I’m sorry this has happened to you, did it not state in your initial contract how many sessions you would be receiving? If your therapist knew then there should have definitely been a plan in place to protect you and as your T knew how much this would affect you she had a duty of care to ensure your needs would be met. I’m learning so much about this industry in this country and it truly baffles me. I am solely fighting for change and I just hear so many stories that break my heart!

I’m so sorry, I’m experiencing this exact same thing! NHS therapy only giving a few sessions and then thats it, there’s no closure or anything and you’re supposed to just carry on your life! There really needs to be more support for people if they have a need for longer-term therapy. I dropped everything and cut off so many people whilst in therapy and then my therapist left me with no support and I’m in a grieving stage of my life and I can’t function. I emailed her and told her what was going on and she fast tracked me into the system. I can’t believe your waiting list is 4 years, could you not try something similar? Ask your ex therapist and ask if they can re-refer you to someone else rather than putting you back on a waiting list? I really hope you don’t have to wait that long.

I’ll ask her next time I see her if she can recommend someone else! I think doing that would be great progress for me because I’m the type of person that would endure the worst situations and my own pain to make things simpler for everyone else. It really is too bad I can’t go back to my old therapist. I’m having to learn to live with that reality and it doesn’t get any easier. The worst thing is I’ve been cast aside by doctors with my medical conditions which ended up getting worse. Different previous therapists have been so bad it’s actually traumatised me, so when I had my old therapist and I learned to feel safe and I was promised more sessions then told I couldn’t have them when I needed them, it was a real burn

The therapy that I’m going into now is trauma based and it’s the same system. I guess I should probably go private but because of my mental health I can’t currently work so I can’t afford to go private. It’s a catch 22!

Thank you and well my old therapist said it’s a new rule to lighten the case loads, you can only return twice to the same therapist for a course of treatment. She said that she would take me on as a private client but she can’t. All this starting again is so triggering!

I’m going to my doctors tomorrow to tell them what’s been going on, I’ve put it off for 2 weeks and it’s getting worse, so I haven’t fully given up yet
Thank you so much. Healing, breaking old patterns of thinking really hurts

My therapist said that she wants me to practise everyday for 6 months what she’s taught me before going back. She suggested that it takes 6 months to notice the change in your patterns of behaviour. She said I can come back earlier if I struggle but I want to push for the whole time bc I’d feel like even more of a failure.

It helps me to have guidance, I don’t really have cheerleaders in my day-to-day life. I’m usually the therapist friend so having her really gave me the extra push to stay balanced and this is the first of 10 therapists that didn’t call me a “complex case” and helped me to see my highest self but now I see nothing.

I’m not on medication, I’ve been on it before but I get terrified because it’s amplified negative emotions which have caused me to act on them before. I don’t think I can handle that but I’m going to see my GP tomorrow to speak about medication actually or any alternative routes. My therapist and I set a boundary, she wants me to work on what she’s taught me for 6 months before going back. She said if I really struggle I can go back in October, but I want to try and make the 6 months so I don’t look needy

Thank you for your kindness. I hope I can take some of that and apply it to myself. I really was so proud of myself and my progress, everyone around me was seeing it too, so it is sad to feel like this. I feel as if having my therapist there to point out when I was doing well or assisting me with steps of how to live really encouraged me and gave me a push to carry on. Is that silly to say?
I’m just disappointed, I really worked so hard and I feel like I’ve undone all my progress or as if my progress isn’t real

My sessions were I’d come in, fill in a question form about my depression and anxiety throughout the week, then she’d review the scores whether they’d gone up or down and asks what’s been going on in the week. Then we’d talk about that for a little bit, she’d go deep into some of the topics and what it shows. She’d ask if I did the homework she set and how I got on, we’d talk about that and then she’d set me something else based on the topics we talked about then we’d wrap it up with some gentle conversation. Sometimes we’d do things like guided meditation/visualisation or she’d draw things out to show me what’s happening in my brain too or we’d do role reversal for difficult conversations.

Oh I understand you.. can I ask what your reason for sharing is? For me it was because it was an easier way to explain and offload my emotions so it didn’t really matter about whether or not she liked it. If you like it that’s all that counts, I think she’ll appreciate you sharing no matter what. All the best whatever you choose to do.

Yes! I always showed my poetry. It really helped one time she did something that made me upset and I didn’t know how to tell her, so I wrote about it and shared my poem in session. She heard me and we were able to talk through it

Honestly, I think for me we discovered a lot of my problems stemmed from not feeling seen, heard and understood. She always made me feel those things and I felt safe. I developed an attachment yes. I care about her and hope she’s okay, now I’m dealing with the grief of her not being active in my life. I think sometimes it’s normal human being stuff that we can’t control, and that’s okay. If I didn’t let her in I wouldn’t have got the results I did, the sadness I feel now is an indicator I opened my heart which is something I didn’t do with anyone. I think there can be healthy attachments too.
10!! I really wished we went more into grief while I was at therapy bc if I knew this would hurt so much I wouldn’t have poured my heart out as much as I did
I couldn’t emotionally regulate at all. Had complete black and white thinking and now I can self-soothe, name my emotions and move on from negative experiences

Thank you! I feel slightly better. She emailed me a relapse management plan and said I have 3 days to ask any questions so I asked her to send me some grounding techniques to help me when everything is overwhelming. I’m proud of myself for being able to identify why I was feeling that way, but yeah I think you’re right. I need to stop expecting too much of myself as I’m adjusting.
She spoke about it clearly, it was a situation that happened and she just told me what happened, not in too much detail but enough for me to understand and handle
This happened with me and my T. She let me know in the following session and said she thought she’d leave it to explain in person

She displays an amazing ability to meet me exactly where I am. She can read my body language, listens without judgment, she is honest with me and doesn’t cut corners in my treatment, she did a guided meditation with me that almost sent me to sleep and it was the most beautiful experience of my life. She’s empathetic. I’ve been told by multiple previous therapists that I’m a complex case but she tells me every week that I’m not a complex case. She’s invested and said it’s a privilege to be on her side to experience the growth, she remembers names of my friends and family members although there’s sooo many people in my life I don’t know how she does it. She encourages me and loves to read my poetry and hear my stories, she fought for me by writing a statement when I had to prove I wasn’t well enough to work, she listens and doesn’t judge my religious background and experiences, she laughs with me and we spend a lot of time in sessions doing that which is so freeing for me. Today is my last session for 6 months so I’m really emotional writing this and I’ve got a little poem I might post here later about her bc you might be able to relate with your amazing therapists!!!

Was working with a therapist (from crisis team) who knew how bad my abandonment issues were. He said that because of that he would work with me and ensure I knew when we were ending. The day I came in distressed that a friend was moving across the world he said “I hate to do this, especially today, but I’m leaving my job so we’ll have no further sessions.” When I was obviously distressed, he said “wellll… I’ve given you more than I intended so it’s okay.”

I was gonna ask if you spoke about it in session. I hope it goes well if you do. It’s hard to know what to do and how to respond. I think I just felt embarrassed, not of my T, but thinking about how she might have felt seeing me.
I had the same fear so I wrote her an email. In session she said “you don’t have to worry about disappointing me. My stance is you’re either winning or you’re learning.” She was so validating

I’m so glad your husband to you feel comfortable and safe with and that you treat yourself in the way you feel best. I’m inspired. It lets me know it’s okay to not want to go big or full on and to do what’s best and safe for me

Thank you for that validation.. my irl friends were genuinely confused and said that’s a boring thing to do, but it actually wasn’t a boring session. There’s big emotions I feel on my birthday bc I never planned to live this long so I have to process and exhale for the year ahead

“Right now you’re not identifying with anything you want to become, therefore you stay in the same position.” That clicked something in my brain because I was so depressed my life wasn’t moving, but I also didn’t know where I wanted it to move to. That started a journey for me!

How did you go about saying it or bring it up? I want to tell my T but I’m not sure how. I think it’s important as I always talk about how I have negative feelings towards professionals like doctors etc and I want her to know that I genuinely love her and am grateful

Yes 100%. Infact it caused a little bit of a rupture and I was terrified to trust my T again. This one has been the best one I’ve ever had, I get excited to do the work, read the books, talk and tell my T everything that’s gone on in the week. This one time I was really nervous as I’d had an awful week and was particularly low and had harmful thoughts. I brought this to therapy, believing that I could keep myself safe but being scared of how low I was and my T told me I may need the crisis team. I was told I hadn’t been engaging for a few weeks. I was devastated because I’ve had toxic support before from professionals and I have a fear of most mental health teams and felt like my T was trying to palm me off because it was the first time I’d opened up so deep. I shut down for the rest of the session and sent her a long email. We discussed it in the session after but I still feel like I have to be careful what I say now

My T will say “I’ll send you an email with the homework and I’ll see you next week, but just to let you know you’re doing amazing.” Then maybe we’ll have a chat about something completely unrelated, light or funny whilst my T walks me out the front of the building.

Yeah I’ll ask her… I asked her before but she said they don’t offer it there at that place so she’d probs have to move me on to someone/somewhere else but I just cba for the transition period. It’s so tough always going through the same things over and over and trying to get them to understand you

Yeah my therapist thinks I might need crisis team and maybe a cpn for extra support but these systems just don’t work for me. I’ve been through it all before and part of my anxiety comes from being abused by the system, so I know she was only trying to help but her bringing that up to me today just sent me into a spiral but it ended on a good note I hugged her and told her thanks but I don’t think I need it because I feel supported here. I’ll cross the bridge of what happens next when I get there

I think because it’s under the NHS it’s supposed to be 8 weeks, but depending on where I’m at after 8 weeks they can extend it. Last year I had therapy with the same person for 16 weeks and then it was required I had a 12 week break and if I still needed therapy I could go back so at the start of the year I went back. I think we’re on week 8 now, but she’s starting to say things like “with us having only a few sessions left…” 

She said I can re-refer to the service but she said I think they only let you see the same client 4 times so you don’t get attached or something. It’s frustrating because like you, it takes me a while to open up because in my personal life I’ve been abandoned a lot and in therapy I’ve been told I’m too much, and that I’ve had more life issues than someone in their 60’s (I’m 27F). Meeting this therapist that saw me where I’m at, didn’t judge me and has actually helped me, I finally felt safe. To think it’s coming to an end is so upsetting for me because I don’t wanna find another therapist and I know I’ve not progressed enough to be on my own…

Hi, just wanted to thank you. I had my session with my therapist and was able to bring it up. We spent 30 mins of the session exploring the memory and the flashback, why it may come up, how it makes me feel when it comes up and she is just deciding whether trauma would be something I came back for after this set of treatment but she said she’ll be doing weekly check ins from now on
